# Young AI Leaders Gweru Hub

> Youth-led AI hub in Gweru, Zimbabwe — young leaders building ethical AI, digital skills and social impact for communities across Zimbabwe and Southern Africa.

Young AI Leaders Gweru Hub is a youth-led AI and technology community in Gweru, Midlands Province, Zimbabwe, and a hub of the ITU AI for Good Young AI Leaders Community. We connect young innovators across Zimbabwe and Southern Africa through ethical artificial intelligence, community technology, social innovation and hands-on AI literacy — rooted in local languages, local context and youth leadership.

- Website: https://yailgweru.github.io/
- Location: Gweru, Midlands Province, Zimbabwe
- Network: Young AI Leaders Community, ITU's AI for Good
- Email: yail.gweru@gmail.com

## Projects

- [AI Literacy for All](https://yailgweru.github.io/projects/ai-literacy-for-all.html): Community project (SDG 4: Quality Education). Online and in-person sessions that equip people with practical knowledge of AI tools and best practices.

- [Build with AI Buildathon · Southern Africa Jam](https://luma.com/chg80xvi): Thu, Apr 30 · Midlands State University Main Campus, Room 59, Gweru. A satellite session of the regional AI buildathon.
